summary: Wise Group plc filed a Form 6-K disclosing open-market repurchases of its Class A ordinary shares executed 5-9 October 2026: 996,168 shares on Nasdaq and 1,683,772 on London venues, all via Goldman Sachs International, to be held in treasury. Volume-weighted prices ranged about GBP 8.64-8.87 and USD 11.55-11.80 per share. The buys are part of the buyback announced 21 July 2026, authorizing up to GBP 405 million (roughly $540 million). No premium, close date, or board recommendation applies; buyback execution pace and treasury share accumulation are the watch items.
